author: Robin Noguier
why: Elevated Bromo sunrise landscape with layered mountains and cool dawn colour; photographer describes hiking to the opposite viewpoint. Sony ILCE-7M2 photograph.

author: Sébastien Lavalaye
why: Source confirms sunrise from King Kong Hill: Bromo volcanic complex, smoke rising from the crater and thick clouds filling the caldera.

author: Arya Krisdyantara
why: Bromo surrounded by morning clouds; atmospheric alternative emphasising the volcano and sea of mist.

author: Esaias Tan
why: Confirmed sunrise in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park; smoking crater and golden-hour mountain scenery.

author: Lim Jia Le
why: 11809 × 7873; sunrise, volcanic smoke and colourful sky, with ample resolution for a near-square crop.

author: Sergey Guk
why: 5573 × 3981; wide sunrise view of Bromo's volcanic landscape, relatively close to the desired card proportions.

author: Huey Sze Chan
why: Photographer explicitly identifies Penanjakan viewpoint, Bromo, Batok, Semeru and Widodaren; morning rays and mist.

author: Joshua Kettle
why: Bromo complex just before sunrise, with Batok and Semeru forming the recognisable layered silhouette.

author: Domjahit Photography
why: 5144 × 3430; mist, sunrise colour and wildflower foreground give depth to the volcanic landscape.

author: Rowan Heuvel
why: Documented Bromo sunrise photograph with a prominent white smoke plume and soft dawn colours.
